decisions.reason: We would keep the coolant pressure booster system because as a core-adjacent launch in a growing industry it shows no visible aspiration-level failure and our size and slack allow further commercialization.

We would keep the coolant nozzles line because its modular variants complement the established coolant offer and there is no clear sign that results have fallen sufficiently below internal or peer aspirations to justify withdrawal.

We would keep the scraper belt chip conveyor, but monitor it more closely, because it is somewhat more adjacent than core products even though surviving the first review suggests performance is acceptable enough to continue.

We would keep the hinged belt chip conveyor because, after weaker products were already pruned, this adjacent conveyor appears good enough relative to aspirations to retain while we continue learning from the market.
